metric_explanations.precision: Proportion of positive litter detections that were genuinely litter.
metric_explanations.recall: Proportion of actual litter items successfully detected by the model.
metric_explanations.f1_score: Harmonic mean of precision and recall.
metric_explanations.map_50: Mean Average Precision at IoU threshold = 0.50.
metric_explanations.map_50_95: Mean Average Precision averaged over IoU thresholds from 0.50 to 0.95 (step 0.05).
